agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is single ball launched upward into ceiling with e=1. After elastic bounce velocity magnitude increases (41.42->41.68->43.3->44.99) instead of being conserved (minus gravity potential change), gaining ~120 J in 3 steps. Cause likely incorrect restitution impulse / positional correction adding kinetic energy on ceiling collision. Changing e from 1 to 0 removes energy gain.
